'''2008 Official Leagues''' were the official Star Wars CCG leagues of the [[Players Committee]] for 2008, announced by its Organized Play team on 19 March 2008. Leagues were meant to give a platform for play at the local level in a less formal setting than a tournament, and local league directors had complete control of the form and format of their league. Each qualifying league could award one automatic Day 2 bye to its league champion, with the champion decided by the league's own system.<ref name="pc-sid79">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=79 2008 League Information], swccgpc.com (19 March 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080712071956/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=79 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Requirements ==

* Each league had to run one qualifying event each month from April through August 2008 (five events).<ref name="pc-sid79" />
* Qualifying events had to have four participants.<ref name="pc-sid79" />
* Each league registered with the PC League Coordinator, [[Evan Fitzgerald]], and stated its method for selecting a champion.<ref name="pc-sid79" />
* Leagues posted the results of each event in a forum for that league.<ref name="pc-sid79" />
* Each league paid a fee of $25.<ref name="pc-sid79" />

== Suggested scoring ==

The announcement suggested three ways to run a league:<ref name="pc-sid79" />
* Run each event as a Swiss tournament, with the league winner decided by cumulative victory points plus differential over every event the player attended.
* Run each event as a Swiss tournament, with players scoring points for their placement and the number of attendees: with 6 players the winner receives 6 points, 2nd place 5 and last place 1; with 10 players the winner receives 10 points and 4th place 7.
* Run each event as open play, with points for games played and extra points for victories.

Leagues were encouraged to play whatever their local players wanted, mixing formats: constructed, [[Cube]], [[Sealed Deck|sealed]], [[Classic]], [[Episode I]], "Bespin and beyond" and others.<ref name="pc-sid79" />
